apps.subtitle: Windows games on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: A fast, controller-friendly launcher that runs Windows games on iOS and iPadOS with Steam and GOG built in, powered by Wine, FEX and Metal via DXMT.

versions.localizedDescription:
**BCD is in alpha:** an early stage of development, before beta. Many games run, many do not yet, and things can break between builds. When a game fails, please send a log.

This build brings everything since 0.1.626: a large round of fixes from the logs you sent with Send Log and from Discord reports, a look of your own for touch controls, and the fix for Rockstar's new launcher.

> **Rockstar Games Launcher update (3 November):** Rockstar's new launcher (1.0.110) needs a Windows file BCD gives only on request (`tbs.dll`), so Red Dead Redemption 2, GTA V and the other Rockstar games stopped with "Unable to launch game, please try reinstalling the game". Their recommended settings now include it, also in the online list that 0.1.600 and later builds read. If your game still shows the box, use **Reset to Recommended** on its page (see below), or add `env.MADEIRA_OPTIN_DLLS = tbs` to its config.

## New

- **Your own look for touch controls:** in the touch editor, a selected control has a **Look** tab (the paintbrush). Pick its shape (Standard, Circle, Square, or Rectangle with a width-to-height slider) and give it your own text, for example "INV" on an inventory key; the text is drawn as large as it fits inside the control. The look is saved with the layout and travels in shared layouts; a control without one looks as before.
- **Helper memory takes more:** with Helper memory on, BCD now keeps taking memory from the helper while the device has room (it no longer stops at BCD's own memory warning), counts free and reusable pages, and can be used without the swap file. `env.MADEIRA_POOL_MORE = 0` in a game's config brings back the previous behaviour. Thanks to rtmtree for these changes.
- **Atomic operations on shared code memory:** games stopped when they used certain atomic instructions (lock-free counters and compare-and-swap) on memory BCD keeps writable through a second mapping; the log said `[store-undecoded]`. BCD now carries them out (in the last days: Jetboard Joust, ReSkate, Tomb Raider, CrossCode, BeamNG.drive, GTA IV, S.T.A.L.K.E.R., Minecraft Java Edition, GeoGuessr, Cuphead and others).
- **Long sessions with many threads:** BCD's tables of threads (512 entries) and their entry slots (1,024) were never given back, so a session that started thousands of threads failed with a crash or a frozen game (Fallout: New Vegas after a long play, Messiah, NARUTO SHIPPUDEN: Ultimate Ninja STORM 3, FINAL FANTASY VII's launcher). The places of threads that ended are now reused; sessions with fewer threads run exactly as before.

## Messages and hints

Text only; none of these changes a setting.

- **JIT:** when StikDebug was attached long before Play and no longer answered, the message says so: quit BCD, open it, tap Enable JIT and start the game within half a minute. A copy of BCD that cannot get JIT at all (no get-task-allow) is told at the first library screen.
- **Phones with a 2.3 GB memory limit:** a large game's page shows the memory note and the graphics hint.
- **BCD Dock:** clearer texts when Steam starts no copy-protection job for a game, when Steam's offline start cannot find the game's folder, and when Steam still counts your account as playing elsewhere.
- **Settings:** a game's Windows version option says that newer games refuse XP and Vista (GTA V stops); the helper memory test says it cannot run inside LiveContainer; the in-game menu's pointer and controller notes point to Mouse-look and to XInput.
- **Steam Cloud:** offline, on a device where no Steam game was started online yet, the cloud message adds that Steam may refuse the start: start it once online.
- **Auto-tune results** no longer pop up while a game is running, and a result that only repeats what the running game already has is not shown.

## Fixes and improvements

> **Tried one of these games on an earlier build? Reset its settings first.** A game keeps the settings it had until you reset them, so without this it may start with the old ones that failed. On the game's page: **Options › Recommended settings › Reset to Recommended**, then check that **Options › Auto-tune › Auto-tune this game** is on, and start the game again.

Each fix targets the error a log showed; most could not be tested on a device yet, so a game may now get further and still stop at a later point. If it does, please send a new log: it names the next problem. "Known stop" means Auto-tune now names the stop and stops trying, instead of spending starts on settings that cannot help. "Diagnostics" means the recommended settings only add log lines, so the next log can name the cause.

### Games

- **Rockstar games** (Red Dead Redemption 2, GTA V Legacy and Enhanced, GTA IV, GTA San Andreas - The Definitive Edition, Red Dead Redemption, Max Payne 3): the launcher fix above. Also: GTA IV through BCD Dock reserves its 32-bit game's address window when the session starts (the game was refused it a minute in); GTA V from Epic starts through BCD Host again; GTA V with Windows XP in its settings is told to go back to Windows 10.
- **Alan Wake:** some lit surfaces were skipped because BCD's Direct3D 9 layer did not pass certain vertex shader outputs to the pixel shader. Fixed.
- **Arcade Paradise and TOEM:** both stop two seconds in on an empty list of displays; their recommended settings try Windows' own monitor identity and mode list (an experiment: one start decides it).
- **Baldur's Gate 3 (its launcher):** the .NET launcher spun for minutes with no window; new recommended settings with the fix Jetboard Joust and Stardew Valley use.
- **Batman: Arkham Asylum GOTY, Don't Starve Together, Mafia II (Steam), The Witcher: Enhanced Edition:** the DirectX setup of the first start failed and the game started only after BCD was restarted. BCD ships what that setup installs, so their recommended settings mark it as done and the first Play starts the game.
- **The Witcher: Enhanced Edition:** the game quit two seconds in without the registry values Steam's install script writes on Windows; BCD Dock now writes them for it.
- **Cult of the Lamb** and **PEAK:** new recommended settings with the lines Auto-tune had found (Unity's code memory fix; for Cult of the Lamb also the pause while BCD is in the background).
- **Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher 3:** their launcher crashed when Auto-tune had run the game without a code copy; the recommended settings now bind its data imports.
- **Dead or Alive 6 and Last Round:** the game needs `XInputUap.dll`; BCD now has it for the games that ask (new recommended settings).
- **Dokimon Quest:** the touch controller is connected from the start of the session, so the game sees it.
- **Enshrouded:** when the game ended, BCD kept working on the closed game instead of ending the session; fixed. Its Steam library is newer than the Steam client BCD Dock runs, which Auto-tune now names (known stop).
- **Football Manager 26:** "Failed to load il2cpp"; new recommended settings (the same three lines as Football Manager 27).
- **Football Manager 27:** after 26 s of play the game stopped right after it asked Windows about its security features; its recommended settings now give complete answers (an experiment).
- **GrandChase:** the game needs `HTTPAPI.dll`; BCD now has it for the games that ask (new recommended settings).
- **Halo: The Master Chief Collection:** the code memory filled 14 s into play; new recommended settings keep its 64-bit libraries out of it.
- **Hitman: Contracts and Guacamelee! Gold Edition:** their folders carry an old copy of a Windows library (`msvcrt.dll`) that Windows never loads; BCD now uses its own (new recommended settings).
- **Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders:** BCD's repair of a Unity memory race now covers the case it missed, and the recommended settings stop the race itself.
- **Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered, Miles Morales, Palworld, RoboCop: Rogue City, Ride, Ghost of Tsushima:** quitting the game was recorded as a crash (and Auto-tune tried settings after it). The game's own exit status is now kept.
- **Messiah:** it now starts (its start script needs Windows command-line tools that BCD had only for 32-bit programs), and its sound devices now open (new recommended settings).
- **FINAL FANTASY VII (its launcher):** "NoDriver calling waveOutOpen": Windows' sound devices could not start in the launcher's process. Fixed with its recommended settings.
- **Mighty No. 9, Outlast, Satisfactory:** memory probes Windows allows were taken for an endless loop and the game's thread was ended. They now simply fail, as on Windows.
- **Need for Speed: Most Wanted and Underground 2:** Auto-tune tries exact x87 math and plain code memory for the track loader's stop (an experiment).
- **NW.js games** (The Genesis Order and others): the window stayed blank because the game's crash reporter refused settings BCD added to the game. Fixed.
- **Over the Hill, Euro Truck Simulator 2, Schedule I, The Wolf Among Us Remastered, Sable, FINAL FANTASY XV demo:** iOS closed the game while a scene loaded gigabytes of textures; their recommended settings drop the largest texture level only while the game is close to its memory limit.
- **PAYDAY 2:** its Discord library needs `qwave.dll`; new recommended settings give it.
- **Ren'Py games:** the game's Python start-up found the iOS version file and stopped; BCD now hides it.
- **Resident Evil 5:** the game decrypts part of its own code while running; its recommended settings make the emulator translate that code only when it runs (slower translation, the right code).
- **Rotfront:** the game's crash handler now runs (it needs `dbgcore.dll`); the next log carries the game's own fatal message.
- **S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky:** a shader that names a value "point" did not compile and the game stopped with the Direct3D 9 renderer. Fixed.
- **Shroom and Gloom, The Alto Collection and other games on phones that cannot read compressed textures:** the textures are expanded and iOS closed the game; Auto-tune now drops their largest level.
- **The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim (the original 32-bit edition):** its sound engine could stop the game at the start; Auto-tune gives the fix (`env.MADEIRA_XAUDIO2_CALLBACK_ORDER = 1`).
- **Slay the Spire 2** (its own keyed event) and **Ghost of Tsushima** (swap in broad mode, 1 GB): already online since 0.1.626 in the recommended list, now built in.
- **TEKKEN 7:** after about 35 s of play, a thread left over by NVIDIA's SDK (which cannot start without GeForce Experience) used freed memory and ended the game. Its recommended settings end only that thread and the game goes on.
- **The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark:** its code rewrote itself millions of times through BCD's slow path and it never finished loading; new recommended settings.
- **The Witcher 3:** a copy without its own files (`REDGalaxy64.dll` and others) is named; Auto-tune tells the game the address space it can really get (an experiment).
- **Unreal Gold:** every start stopped at the first fire texture: the texture code changes its own instructions and the emulator ran part of it twice. Its recommended settings make the emulator resume exactly at those writes.
- **The Windows desktop:** a service starting with the desktop took the touch input away, so taps no longer reached the Start button or the icons. Fixed.
- **Known stops** (named, no setting helps yet): Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Darksiders Warmastered Edition (Vulkan only), Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed (Direct3D 7 needs OpenGL), SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance, Yakuza 5, Fallout 3's stop on an empty object, DELTARUNE (a second copy of its program), Resident Evil Requiem demo, BeamNG.drive's built-in browser (address space), FINAL FANTASY XIV (its WebView2 setup cannot finish), EA games with Javelin anti-cheat.
- **Diagnostics only:** Aliens: Colonial Marines, Bendy and the Ink Machine, BioShock, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Half-Life engine games (Half-Life, Counter-Strike, Condition Zero), Hitman: Blood Money, Hotline Miami, Muv-Luv photonflowers, Project Zomboid, Prototype 2, Requiem: Avenging Angel, Tales of Zestiria, Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines.

### Launchers and stores

- **Steam through BCD Dock:**
  - a slow first sign-in now gets more time before the game's licence list times out;
  - when writing Steam's client entries fails, BCD tries once more and says which part failed;
  - when Steam's offline start cannot find the game, the log says which folder it expected;
  - a copy-protected start where Steam has no job to do can go on with `env.MADEIRA_DOCK_CEG_ZERO_JOBS = 1` (an experiment; Auto-tune offers it);
  - BCD no longer waits for ever while it prepares the Dock (30 s at most per step);
  - one-time installs cut short by leaving the app are offered once more.
- **The 32-bit Steam client on installs without extended virtual addressing:** it ran out of room for the emulator; BCD now lets it use the part held back for 64-bit programs.
- **EA app:** its installer shows a web page and waited behind Wine's download prompt; it now waits until **Settings › HTML engine for installers** is installed, and its install session gets the EA app's settings. FIFA 22's EA helper gets the library it needs (the first step).
- **Rockstar:** the launcher fix above; plain messages when Social Club's browser has no room on a small address map, when a folder of the Steam edition is started without Steam, and when Red Dead Redemption's program cannot be placed.
- **Ubisoft launcher:** its protection stopping it is named (known stop).

### Auto-tune

- **How it judges a start:**
  - a session that spins for minutes without drawing a frame counts as hung;
  - a memory close at 90 % of the limit or more counts as certain (the swap file comes sooner);
  - the previous session's lines at the top of a log are no longer taken as evidence;
  - the Steam client's own crash reporter is not the game's crash;
  - a game's own exit while it is closing is not a crash.
- **What it says:** about 90 new rules from your logs, with fixes or known-stop messages (listed per game above).

### Logs

New lines so that the next log names a cause: where a waiting thread entered its last system call, the call that jumped to nowhere in a 32-bit game, the memory views and requests behind a 32-bit fault, the 32-bit call chain of a game's own fatal error, how old the JIT attach was, which JIT pool region a debugger break used, the x86 preset in use, the Steam connection's own log, the Dock's licence wait and failed setup steps, and the x86 translator's compile and flush costs. Game logs copied into BCD's log no longer include your account names.

### Under the hood

- New switches, off by default, for experiments: `env.MADEIRA_USD_OSVERSION` (the Windows version block that Windows programs read), `env.MADEIRA_POOL_LAZY_WINDOWS` (Helper memory without permanent windows), `env.MADEIRA_MESSAGE_CLASS`, `env.MADEIRA_THREAD_FAULT_ISOLATE`, `env.MADEIRA_FEX_MOFFS_RIP`, `env.MADEIRA_XAUDIO2_CALLBACK_ORDER`, `env.MADEIRA_DOCK_DIRECTX_FIRST`, `env.MADEIRA_WOW_PLACEHOLDER_SLOTS`, `env.MADEIRA_PAD_EARLY_SLOT`.
- BCD's x86 translator: RDTSCP and RDPID answer (Hearts of Iron IV), a 32-bit thread that gets no emulator memory ends alone, and the code-cache walk skips a thread without caches.
- New host checks for every change of this build.

**Known issues:**
- Frame generation with MetalFX upscaling can make the graphics driver stop the game after a minute or two. Turn Frame generation off for now.
- GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 from Steam: the Rockstar Launcher sometimes says Steam is not running (error 113, "please reinstall") although it is. Fully close BCD and start the game again.
- Very long GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 sessions through BCD Dock can stop when the emulator's address area is full. Fully close BCD (swipe it away) and start again.

Install help, game reports and ideas: join the [BCD-Games Discord](https://discord.gg/43TmupTVug).

**BCD.ipa**: the unsigned IPA, for sideloading with SideStore, AltStore or LiveContainer. It needs iOS 18 or later and JIT; the README has the details.
**BCD-source.tar.xz**: the complete source of this build with all its submodules (GPL-3.0).
